window.row_unit: observed admitted market bar (H1); closures occupy no slot
window.note: no interpolation over closures; not a clock-hour window

groups.name: t3_unit_C
groups.rule: T3 combination: every per-group choice of the decision

business.execution_timing: decision after the completed bar b (availability = bar start + 1 h); fill at open(b + 1); SL and TP broker-side on every order; SL and TP touched in the same bar -> SL first; forced flat has priority
business.activity_rule: orders_per_week >= 2.0 as the PERIOD AVERAGE; weeks_below_min_orders reported; no forced trading
business.agent_state: none: no agent feedback in the observation

labels.note: training-only hindsight demonstrations; never an observation; opportunity/both is a separate experiment

scope: DIAGNOSTIC pipeline control 'synthetic_clean' derived from recipe_DIAGNOSTIC_SYNTHETIC_dbc52a0da2d5638a (fold wf2022); never a result, never a release

scaler.nan_policy: nanmean/nanstd over TRAIN; empty TRAIN, all-NaN feature or non-finite constant refused; NaN windows excluded
scaler.transform: (x - mean) / std per feature; std = 1 where rule == std_zero_to_one

stationarity.rule: ADF p > 0.05 and KPSS p < 0.05 on TRAIN -> NON_STATIONARY
